title: Long-Distance Call Frequency
dataSources: Relationship check-ins (`relationship:checkin`), date nights (`datenight:log`), gift ideas (`giftidea:item`), keep-in-touch contacts (`keptintouch:contact`).
app: Relationship and togetherness logs — shared check-in apps, date-night and gift-idea lists, and stay-in-touch reminders — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=keptintouch:contact event=call
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as calls, sum(duration_min) as minutes by person _time
| sort - _time
description: Tracks how often and how long you talk with long-distance loved ones each week, keeping far-away bonds strong.
value: Distance erodes contact by default; a call-frequency view helps you keep important relationships alive on purpose.
implementation: Log calls into `index=personal`; schedule weekly and review call frequency and duration per person.
visualization: Column chart of weekly calls and minutes per person.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how often you call faraway family and friends, helping you keep in touch across the distance.
